rationale: Both candidates independently discovered the same underlying issue as the ground-truth P2 comment (trust_remote_code incompatible with kernels 0.13.x) and correctly noted it was already resolved by a later commit, giving both strong recall. X is heavily padded with near-duplicate 'claim-refuted' entries restating the same stale-PR-body point, which hurts signal-to-noise despite solid grounding and useful code-suggestion blocks. Y is more concise and surfaces a genuinely deeper, non-obvious finding (broad except swallowing transient vs. permanent failures, now sticky process-wide) plus a specific dead-code claim about kernels>=0.15, giving it a slight edge in precision and overall value despite carrying more unverifiable external-library claims.
